race.comment: KENSINGTON'S JEWEL (2) has to rebound from a plain last at this track when beaten as odds-on favourite, but the return to 1200m is a major positive given four wins and one placing from eight starts at the distance. He also beat SALT LAKE BETTY in a Class 5 at Isisford two runs back. SALT LAKE BETTY (9) answered that with a CL4 win at Longreach, scoring by just under 2L lengths despite early contact and difficulty getting clear late. CROWN REACH (5) arrives off a neck second at Mt Isa and another placing at Cloncurry, with enough consistency this prep to stay right in the contest. BOLD SMUGGLER (6) will find this easier and holds minor appeal.
